messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The process of an Office Supply Request starts when any employee of the organization submits an office supply request. Once the requirement is registered, the request is received by the immediate supervisor of the employee requesting the office supplies. The supervisor must approve or ask for a change, or reject the request. If the request is rejected the process will end. If the request is asked to make a change then it is returned to the petitioner / employee who can review the comments for the change request. If the request is approved it will go to the purchase department that will be in charge of making quotations (using a subprocess) and select a vendor. If the vendor is not valid in the system the purchase department will have to choose a different vendor. After a vendor is selected and confirmed, the system will generate and send a purchase order and wait for the product to be delivered and the invoice received. In any case the system will send a notification to let the user know what the result was. In any of the cases, approval, rejection or change required the system will send the user a notification.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_OfficeSupplyRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/officesupply">

  <bpmn:process id="OfficeSupplyRequestProcess" name="Office Supply Request Process" isExecutable="true">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SupervisorDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_PurchaseDept" name="Purchase Department">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectVendor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_VendorValid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseDifferentVendor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmVendor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRejectNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendChangeNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendApproveNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitInvoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendFinalNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Start -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Office Supply Request Submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- Register -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register Request">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SF8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Supervisor review -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SupervisorReview" name="Review Request">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" name="Supervisor Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Reject branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRejectNotification" name="Send Rejection Notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Request Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Change branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendChangeNotification" name="Send Change Required Notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewComments" name="Review Comments and Update Request">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Approve branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendApproveNotification" name="Send Approval Notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Quotation" name="Prepare Quotations">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF11</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart" name="Start Quotation Process">
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubSF1</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestQuotes" name="Request Quotes from Vendors">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubSF1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubSF2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectQuotes" name="Collect Vendor Quotes">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubSF2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubSF3</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareQuotes" name="Compare Quotes">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubSF3</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubSF4</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd" name="Quotations Ready">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubSF4</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubSF1" sourceRef="SubStart" targetRef="Task_RequestQuotes" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubSF2" sourceRef="Task_RequestQuotes" targetRef="Task_CollectQuotes" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubSF3" sourceRef="Task_CollectQuotes" targetRef="Task_CompareQuotes" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubSF4" sourceRef="Task_CompareQuotes" targetRef="SubEnd" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectVendor" name="Select Vendor">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SF14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VendorValid" name="Vendor Valid?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDifferentVendor" name="Choose Different Vendor">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmVendor" name="Confirm Vendor">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GeneratePO" name="Generate and Send Purchase Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitDelivery" name="Wait for Product Delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitInvoice" name="Wait for Invoice Received">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendFinalNotification" name="Send Completion Notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Process Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF2" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_SupervisorReview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF3" sourceRef="Task_SupervisorReview" targetRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF4" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejectNotification" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF5" sourceRef="Task_SendRejectNotification" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF6" name="Change Required" sourceRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" targetRef="Task_SendChangeNotification" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF7" sourceRef="Task_SendChangeNotification" targetRef="Task_ReviewComments" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF8" sourceRef="Task_ReviewComments" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF9" name="Approve" sourceRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" targetRef="Task_SendApproveNotification" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF10" sourceRef="Task_SendApproveNotification" targetRef="SubProcess_Quotation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF11" sourceRef="SubProcess_Quotation" targetRef="Task_SelectVendor" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF12" sourceRef="Task_SelectVendor" targetRef="Gateway_VendorValid" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF13" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_VendorValid" targetRef="Task_ChooseDifferentVendor" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF14" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDifferentVendor" targetRef="Task_SelectVendor" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_VendorValid" targetRef="Task_ConfirmVendor" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF16" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmVendor" targetRef="Task_GeneratePO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF17" sourceRef="Task_GeneratePO" targetRef="Task_WaitDelivery" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF18" sourceRef="Task_WaitDelivery" targetRef="Task_WaitInvoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF19" sourceRef="Task_WaitInvoice" targetRef="Task_SendFinalNotification" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF20" sourceRef="Task_SendFinalNotification" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
